name: Setaram DSC (Setline)

request_framing.notes: request lengths genuinely vary on this device (2 to 14 bytes); one request per TCP segment

session.explanation: Calisto writes to one control register to start and stop a run: 0004 0001 0000 05 starts, 0004 0001 0000 02 stops. Each is sent once, so start_streak is 1. There is no quiet timeout because this instrument is polled continuously between runs - the session ends on the stop command, not on silence.

notes: Derived from a real capture on 2026-08-09 and cross-checked against Calisto's own export of the same run. Sample temperature and heat flow both live in the reply to the 2-byte request 0008, a packed status frame of 23 bytes, at offsets 15 and 19 as big-endian float32. Agreement with Calisto: r=0.999989 / RMSE 0.044 degC for temperature, r=0.999957 / RMSE 0.021 uV for heat flow. Note that 0008 is only polled while a run is in progress, which is what makes it safe to record continuously. The C80's own commands (000100080004, 0001000a0001) are also answered by this device and carry similar-looking values, but they do NOT track what Calisto plots (r=0.73 and r=0.50) - do not assume the C80 profile works here.
